title: picea likiangensis subsp. balfouriana
intro: Picea likiangensis subsp. balfouriana, commonly known as the Balfour's Chinese fir, is a plant species belonging to the family Pinaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Balfour's Chinese fir include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents like terpenoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
